dogecoin.text: @BillyMorse @Dogecoin_Clan @JohnCleese If we can easily sign up for vaccination records on our phones (vaccine "passports", which I think is a terrible name FTR), why can't it be just as easy to include records for medical exemption in an official capacity without divulging actual illnesses?

@BillyMorse @Dogecoin_Clan @JohnCleese No because there are plenty of people that want it, but can't because of medical issues. Also, children can't get vaccinated right now. The point of vaccination is to protect those folks from encountering the virus because it doesn't spread as quickly among vaxxed population
